lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in approximately three horizontal rows and four to five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit highest intensity in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the centroids of the circular spots, creating a distinct rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes are visible in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin, representing commensal organisms.
